text_simplified: The prophets (peace be upon them) hastened to raise their children and pray for their steadfastness upon monotheism and Islam, as Ya'qub, Ibrahim, and Isma'il (peace be upon them) did, and the early Muslims took intense care in directly raising their children. It is a grave mistake to limit educational care to sons while excluding daughters, because the trust is one and parents will be questioned about all of them, and today's daughter is tomorrow's mother who raises future generations.
